source.author: lucan
source.text: Cetera classis abit, summis spoliata carinis: Ut, Pagasaea ratis peteret cum Phasidos undas, Cyaneas tellus emisit in aequora cautes; Rapta puppe minor subducta est montibus Argo, Vanaque percussit pontum Symplegas inanem, Et statura redit.
source.text_original: Cetera classis abit, summis spoliata carinis: / Ut, Pagasaea ratis peteret cum Phasidos undas, / Cyaneas tellus emisit in aequora cautes; / Rapta puppe minor subducta est montibus Argo, / Vanaque percussit pontum Symplegas inanem, / Et statura redit.
source.text_english: The rest of the fleet goes away, stripped of its highest keels: as, when the Pagasaean ship was seeking the waters of the Phasis, the land sent the Cyanean rocks out into the sea; the Argo, with her stern snatched away, was drawn back beneath the mountains, and the Symplegades struck the empty sea in vain, and returned to their former shape.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: taurea vulnifico portat celer aspera plumbo terga Lacon, saltem in vacuos ut bracchia ventos spargat et Oebalium Pagaseia puppis alumnum spectet securo celebrantem litora ludo.
reuse.text_original: taurea vulnifico portat celer aspera plumbo / terga Lacon, saltem in vacuos ut bracchia ventos / spargat et Oebalium Pagaseia puppis alumnum / spectet securo celebrantem litora ludo.
reuse.text_english: The Lacedaemonian, swift, bears on his rough back the bull’s-hide with its wound-making lead, so that at least he may scatter his arms into the empty winds and the Pagasaean ship may watch the Oebalian youth as he sports in safety, making the shore ring with his play.
